text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: This is so frustrating! I can't stand it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I didn't wanna lose ever again!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: So why?! How could this happen?!
choice_data_list: You'll get them next time, Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
choice_data_list: It's perfectly fine to be frustrated!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Don't give me that! I never wanna<n>feel this way
again!
choice_data_list: That defiant spirit will be your best weapon!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Weapon? ...Ya mean this anger and<n>frustration can
help me?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Then... I must've just gotten real<n>strong today!
'Cause no one's felt<n>as frustrated as this before!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Which means I'll definitely win next<n>time! And
when I do, I'm gonna<n>cackle real loud!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: But... I already tried my hardest...
choice_data_list:
Evil never gives up, not until the very end. Isn't that
right?

Evil never gives up, not until the very end. Isn't that
right?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gasp! You're right! Evil will nevergive in!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep fighting... no matter how<n>strong my foes
are!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's what it means to be evil!<n>That's what it
means to be me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. Guess I owe ya one now!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So I'll pay ya back with a victory!<n>Just you
wait—next time, I'm bringin'<n>home the gold!
